name: postslop/workspace
description: Root commands for the Postslop server and clients

scripts-descriptions.deps: Install locked server, web and browser-worker dependencies
scripts-descriptions.setup: Create server/.env if missing and prepare private storage and the database
scripts-descriptions.start: Start the web server, schedule and queues in the background
scripts-descriptions.dev: Run the development server and restart it when files change
scripts-descriptions.restart: Stop and start the background server
scripts-descriptions.reload: Load new code in the background server without dropping its listening socket
scripts-descriptions.server:status: Show all running servers and per-worker request, job and schedule counts; supports --json
scripts-descriptions.cli: Run any Postslop command; pass arguments after --
scripts-descriptions.cua: Run any CrabPHP command; pass arguments after --
scripts-descriptions.accounts:import: Import browser sessions; supports --to for a remote Postslop
scripts-descriptions.build: Build the web client into server/public
scripts-descriptions.browser:setup: Install the private X worker's Firefox browser
scripts-descriptions.raycast:build: Build the Raycast extension and native image helper (macOS)
scripts-descriptions.raycast:check: Typecheck and lint the Raycast extension
scripts-descriptions.test:server: Run core, API and HTTP publishing checks against fakes
scripts-descriptions.test:browser: Run the browser bridge and worker checks against fakes
scripts-descriptions.test: Run all server and browser publishing checks
scripts-descriptions.check: Check PHP formatting, lint, tests and the web build
